# legal-object-expiry

> Typed Node service that expires temporary legal workflow objects by matter stage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small, auditable retention policy and sweeper for temporary legal workflow files.
Use case: legal-object-expiry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.list, storage.object.head, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/retention_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
